name: Disneyland Ronto Roasters "Ronto Wrap" on Warm Pita (Hold Peppercorn Sauce)
whyItWorks: Roasted pork and grilled sausage wrapped in warm, soft pita bread. Asking to hold the spicy peppercorn sauce and crunchy cabbage slaw converts this into a gentle pork wrap.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Ronto Wrap and specifically request 'no peppercorn sauce and no raw cabbage slaw'.
watchOuts: Hold spicy peppercorn sauce and raw cabbage slaw
